dialogues.speaker: Xi the Maid
dialogues.text: I wonder how much longer the young master can last...

dialogues.speaker: Xi the Maid
dialogues.text: Hello. I'm sorry, there were some things on my mind.

dialogues.speaker: Xi the Maid
dialogues.text: That young man whose lips are never far from the words "betting on uncut stones" is the young master of our house.

dialogues.speaker: Xi the Maid
dialogues.text: The current master and the young master argued till they were red in the face just before they parted. But not a few moments after the young master left, the master sent me after him with some traveling expenses.

dialogues.speaker: Xi the Maid
dialogues.text: Our lady seemed quite unworried, saying that the young master would surely return.

dialogues.speaker: Xi the Maid
dialogues.text: Well, he did a similar thing once, when he was younger.

dialogues.speaker: Xi the Maid
dialogues.text: Oh, please do not worry. This is our young master's instruction.

dialogues.speaker: Xi the Maid
dialogues.text: I'm not sure why he insisted that I wear a maid uniform from Mondstadt, though I suspect it is some curious hobby of his.

dialogues.speaker: Xi the Maid
dialogues.text: But since these were his instructions, I will follow them.

dialogues.speaker: Xi the Maid
dialogues.text: ...Me? Well, I don't exactly mind it, although it does feel a bit... weird when people stare as they come and go.

dialogues.speaker: Xi the Maid
dialogues.text: Though our young master is quite feckless and has a difficult temper, he does come up with the strangest requests at times...

dialogues.speaker: Xi the Maid
dialogues.text: ...That said, I would like to thank you for looking after him. I hope that all goes well with you.
